any.name: Shared glTF 2.0 substrate
any.note: The whole-document container: GLB/GLTF io, the third-party oracle, the fixture generator and the core snapshot/diff/inference schema. glTF 2.0 defines exactly one conformance target (a "glTF Asset"), never independently-validatable profiles the way PDF/A or STEP AP214's cc1-cc6 do -- so this stays the shared codec every domain subset below composes with, not a mutation owner in its own right. No mutation resolves here any more (see the 8 domain subsets).

scene.name: Scene graph
scene.note: glTF.schema.json `scene`/`node`: scenes, root-node lists, node hierarchy/transform/child edges.

mesh.name: Meshes and accessors
mesh.note: glTF.schema.json `mesh`/`mesh.primitive`/`accessor`: meshes, primitives, morph targets, typed accessor views.

material.name: Materials and textures
material.note: glTF.schema.json `material`/`texture`/`sampler`/`image`: PBR materials, textures, samplers, images.

skin.name: Skins
skin.note: glTF.schema.json `skin`: joints, inverse bind matrices, skeleton root.

buffer.name: Buffers
buffer.note: glTF.schema.json `buffer`/`bufferView`: binary storage and typed views into it.

asset.name: Asset, document and extensions
asset.note: glTF.schema.json `asset` plus the root document's own extension/extras data and the extensionsUsed/extensionsRequired mechanism itself (not any one ratified KHR_*/EXT_* extension's payload).

members.responsibility: Shared glTF 2.0 io/oracle/generator/schema-core substrate; owns no mutation.
Mesh, primitive, morph-target and accessor mutations.
Material, texture, sampler and image mutations.
Asset metadata, document extension/extras and extension-mechanism mutations.
